english.title: Sing etc or cause annoyance after being ordered to stop - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without first obtaining the permission of Liverpool Airport Limited

(A)_[sang, danced, shouted]_
(B)_[played a musical instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTRUMENT..)]_
(C)_[operated a portable entertainment device, namely **(..SPECIFY DEVICE..)]_

in such a way as to give reasonable cause for annoyance to another person after being ordered to cease such activity by an airport official or constable
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 4(7) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
